sanitization: machine paths converted to repository references
original PNG bytes globally deduplicated by SHA256
limitations: Original prompt/contract hashes refer to local originals; published hashes are listed separately.

Latest tightened repair scope did not complete live reacceptance: both raw replies were [].
Archive is review evidence; running hardware adapters requires local configuration and installed software.
Code published_sha256 is the publication worktree hash; repository_sha256 is the committed blob after Git line-ending normalization.
